description: This file defines a class `Language` that extends `ListableDisplayField`, representing a display field for language-related data in a reporting context within the HRM system. It includes methods to get associated DTO class, entity aliases, and fields used in reports.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A report display field class for handling language data in HRM reports, specifying DTO class and associated entity aliases and fields for report generation.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the DTO associated with this display field, which is `Dto\Language`.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides an array of entity aliases used in database queries, here returning ['language'].

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array indicating which database fields this display field represents, here 'employee.empNumber'.
